newsitem.title: USA: BPA Mon peak firm power unchanged, non-firm lower.
newsitem.headline: BPA Mon peak firm power unchanged, non-firm lower.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left Monday prices for peak firm power unchanged from today, but slightly lowered peak non-firm prices, the agency said Thursday.
BPA continued to offer 300 megawatts (MW) of peak firm power for Monday at $17.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $19.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA's Monday price for firm power during light load hours was unchanged at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.

But BPA cut Monday prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT to $7.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and $8.00 for COB, compared with $9.00 per MWh for all Thursday deliveries. Non-firm power during hours ending 0600 and 2300 PDT was unchanged at $10.00.
The agency also offered power for Saturday and Sunday off-peak hours at similar prices.
Peak firm power for Saturday was offered at $15.00-17.00 per MWh, and at $13.00 for Sunday.
